candidates.hypothesis: A fixed 64 KiB bucket-head cache per DiskMap removes one repeated small read from every point lookup/set while retaining disk-resident nodes and the same rebuildable file format.
candidates.baseline: frozen engine; P01 and P03 are not included
candidates.evidence_for_hypothesis: Prior baseline gprof counted 51006 DiskMap::find calls and 108720 File::read calls on 500x16/100 queries; code inspection identifies an unconditional bucket-head pread in find/set. Counts establish repetition, not runtime dominance.
risks: 64 KiB per live map rather than one global cache
candidates.reason: Correctness and out-of-core checks passed. The second complete three-round seed failed to repeat aggregate benefit, with large timing variation. No removal of unfavorable rounds or adoption based only on the first seed.
